translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Ngʼat mohero puonj mar rieko ohero ngʼeyo,
to ngʼat ma ok winj puonj ofuwo.
Ngʼat maber yudo pwoch kuom Jehova Nyasaye,
to Jehova Nyasaye kwero ngʼat ma timbene richo.
Ngʼato ok nyal gerore motegno kuom richo,
to ngʼat makare ok nyal pudhi.
Dhako ma kite longʼo en osimbo mar chwore,
to dhako ma timbene richo chalo gi nyamuoda manie choke.
Chenro mar ngʼat makare nikare,
to puonj mar joricho en wuondruok.
Weche mag joricho opondo karito chwero remo,
to wach mar joma kare resogi.
Joricho osewiti kendo gilal nono,
to od ngʼat makare osiko ogurore motegno.
Ngʼato ipako kaluwore gi riekone,
to jogo man-gi paro mobam ichayo.
Ber bedo dhano adhana, to in gi jatich,
moloyo wuondori ni in ngʼato, to ionge chiemo.
Ngʼat makare chiwo kony ne gik ma jambe dwaro,
to timbe mag ngʼwono mag ngʼat marach gin mana gero.
Ngʼat matiyo e puothe biro bedo gi chiemo mogundho,
to ngʼat mabayo abaya onge gi rieko.
Joricho dwaro gik moyaki mag jogo mamono,
to tiend joma kare kelo mwandu.
Ngʼat marach imako mana gi wuoyone maricho,
to ngʼat makare tony ne chandruok.
Weche mabeyo mawuok e dho ngʼato miyo obedo gi gik mabeyo,
adiera, tich mar lwete kelone konyruok.
Yor ngʼat mofuwo nenorene ni nikare,
to ngʼat makare chiko ite ne puonj.
Ngʼat mofuwo nyiso mirimbe mapiyo,
to ngʼat mariek mwonyo ayany.
Janeno ma ja-adiera chiwo neno mobidhore,
to janeno ma hango wach wacho miriambo.
Weche mag muomruok chwoyo chuny mana kaka ligangla,
to lew ngʼat mariek kelo ngima.
Dhok ma ja-adiera osiko manyaka chiengʼ,
to lep mariambo bedo mana kuom kinde machwok.
Wuond ni e chuny jogo machano timo marach,
to mor en mar jogo mohero kwe.
Onge gima rach manyalo biro ni ngʼat makare;
to joricho ni kod thagruok mathoth.
Jehova Nyasaye mon kod dhok mariambo,
to omor gi jogo ma jo-adiera.
Ngʼat mariek orito ngʼeyone e iye,
to chuny joma ofuwo wuoyo ma ok opimo.
Tich matek miyo ngʼato bedo gi duongʼ,
to nyawo gikone en tich mar misumba.
Chuny maparore miyo ngʼato bedo mool,
to wach mamuol jiwe.
Ngʼat makare dak gi osiepene e yo mowinjore,
to yor ngʼat marach terogi kama rach.
Jasamuoyo ok nyal yudo dwarone,
to jakinda maratego ongʼeyo ber gige.
Yo makare nitie gi ngima,
e yorno nitie ngima mochwere.
